# Implementation Tasks: Todo App - Phase I

**Note**: This file is generated by `/sp.tasks`. See `.specify/templates/commands/tasks.md` for the execution workflow.

## Implementation Strategy

Build the todo application incrementally following clean architecture principles with models, services, and CLI interface. Each user story should be independently testable and deliver value.

## Dependencies

- User Story 1 (Add/View) must be complete before User Stories 2 and 3
- User Stories 2 and 3 can be developed in parallel after Story 1 is complete

## Parallel Execution Examples

- [P] Tasks within each user story that can be developed in parallel:
  - Model and service layer development can happen in parallel with CLI interface development
  - Unit tests can be written in parallel with implementation

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Add and View Tasks (Priority: P1)

As a user, I want to add tasks to my todo list and view them so that I can keep track of what I need to do.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by adding tasks through the console interface and viewing the list, delivering the basic value of task management.

- [X] T014 [P] [US1] Create CLI command for adding tasks in src/cli/main.py
- [X] T015 [P] [US1] Create CLI command for listing tasks in src/cli/main.py
- [X] T016 [US1] Implement add task functionality with title validation
- [X] T017 [US1] Implement list tasks functionality with formatted display
- [X] T018 [US1] Add error handling for invalid input in add task
- [X] T019 [US1] Test basic add and view functionality

## Phase 4: User Story 2 - Update and Delete Tasks (Priority: P1)

As a user, I want to update or delete tasks so that I can manage my todo list effectively.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by updating/deleting tasks through the console interface, delivering the ability to maintain an accurate todo list.

- [X] T020 [P] [US2] Create CLI command for updating tasks in src/cli/main.py
- [X] T021 [P] [US2] Create CLI command for deleting tasks in src/cli/main.py
- [X] T022 [US2] Implement update task functionality with validation
- [X] T023 [US2] Implement delete task functionality
- [X] T024 [US2] Add error handling for non-existent tasks in update/delete
- [X] T025 [US2] Test update and delete functionality

## Phase 5: User Story 3 - Mark Tasks Complete/Incomplete (Priority: P1)

As a user, I want to mark tasks as complete or incomplete so that I can track my progress.

**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by marking tasks as complete/incomplete through the console interface, delivering the ability to track task completion status.

- [X] T026 [P] [US3] Create CLI command for toggling task status in src/cli/main.py
